title: Mid-Level DevOps Engineer
description: Mid-level DevOps position focused on designing and maintaining infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and observability. Expected to work independently, mentor juniors, and make architectural decisions.

skills.rationale: Advanced Linux skills including service management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting
Production-grade containerization including multi-stage builds, security hardening, and registry management
Kubernetes is central to mid-level DevOps; expected to manage deployments, services, storage, and RBAC
Designing and optimizing CI/CD pipelines with deployment strategies and security gates
IaC is expected at mid-level; modules, state management, and environment separation
Deep knowledge of cloud services including networking, IAM, and managed services
Advanced scripting with error handling, API interaction, and tool development
Load balancing, reverse proxy, SSL/TLS, and cloud networking design
Setting up monitoring stacks, alerting, and implementing observability practices
Collaboration workflows, release management, and automation hooks
Configuration management with roles, templates, and vault is commonly expected
Integrating security scanning, container hardening, and vulnerability management
Growing expectation; ArgoCD/Flux setup and GitOps workflows

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.
